name: Scene-Dependent Video Anomaly Detection Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation suite for detecting anomalous events in video streams where anomaly definitions depend on specific scene context.
evaluation_method: AUC (frame-level ROC), with complementary F1/precision-recall for localization
reputation: A niche academic benchmark used in scene-specific video anomaly detection research with limited but focused adoption.
notes: Scene-dependent definitions make cross-scene benchmarking and generalization difficult; risk of overfitting to scene-specific cues. Dataset size and splits may be limited compared to large-scale video benchmarks; not an LLM benchmark.
